title: Zenodo's removal of 19 June 2026: the record, the mint and the removal census
description: Priority records, forecasts and standing claims documenting the 19 June 2026 removal of the account and records from Zenodo, from GitHub issue #2606 and the reconstructed final-week timeline to the 666 counter image posted on 15 June. Diagnostic Seigniorage III forecasts further account-level removals under the 'verifiable research basis' category with no named decision-maker, the Verifiable Research Basis standard proposes re-auditing the gathered removal cases, and the Platform Erosion Observatory measures Zenodo's removal population and its tombstone ceiling. The page also carries the OpenAIRE moderation-mirror exchange, the Obelus and the Tombstone on Zenodotus, and the source-mapped account of Zenodo's moderation architecture.
